figurative_meaning_en: Temporary color that fades or washes away
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার উচ্ছ্বাসটা কাঁচা রংের মতো, শীঘ্রই মিলিয়ে যাবে।
এই সম্পর্ক কাঁচা রং, স্থায়ী হবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: His enthusiasm is like raw color; it will fade away soon.
This relationship is temporary color; it won't last.
note: Refers to superficial or short-lived changes, often in contexts of emotions or appearances.
